description:
Our favorite superfood comes from flax, one of the oldest fiber crops in the world - known to have been cultivated in ancient Egypt and China. Also called 'linseeds,' flaxseeds are a rich source of micronutrients, dietary fiber, manganese, vitamin B1, and the essential fatty acid alpha-linoleic acid, also known as ALA or omega-3. They are so powerful that King Charlemagne of the 8th century believed so strongly in the health benefits of flaxseed that he demanded his loyal subjects eat the seeds and passed laws to make sure of it. The Latin name for flax is Linum usitatissimum, which means "the most useful," and we couldn't agree more. Omega 3's are considered essential because they are necessary for human health and your body can't make them on its own. You need to get your Omega 3's through the foods you eat and flax is the perfect way to add them to your diet. And, flax seeds are one of the best plant-based sources of omega 3's available. Plus, a recent study from Penn State University suggests that plant-based omega 3 sources such as flax are likely just as effective as the well-publicized marine sources in preventing cardiovascular disease.

description:
Our favorite superfood comes from flax, one of the oldest fiber crops in the world - known to have been cultivated in ancient Egypt and China. Also called 'linseeds,' flaxseeds are a rich source of micronutrients, dietary fiber, manganese, vitamin B1, and the essential fatty acid alpha-linoleic acid, also known as ALA or omega-3. They are so powerful that King Charlemagne of the 8th century believed so strongly in the health benefits of flaxseed that he demanded his loyal subjects eat the seeds and passed laws to make sure of it. The Latin name for flax is Linum usitatissimum, which means "the most useful," and we couldn't agree more. Omega 3's are considered essential because they are necessary for human health and your body can't make them on its own. You need to get your Omega 3's through the foods you eat and flax is the perfect way to add them to your diet. And, flax seeds are one of the best plant-based sources of omega 3's available. Plus, a recent study from Penn State University suggests that plant-based omega 3 sources such as flax are likely just as effective as the well-publicized marine sources in preventing cardiovascular disease.

Son tan poderosos que el rey Carlomagno del siglo VIII creyó tan fuertemente en los beneficios para la salud de la linaza que exigió a sus leales súbditos comer las semillas y aprobaron leyes para asegurarse de ello. description:

Also called 'linseeds,' flaxseeds are a rich source of micronutrients, dietary fiber, manganese, vitamin B1, and the essential fatty acid alpha-linoleic acid, also known as ALA or omega-3. They are so powerful that King Charlemagne of the 8th century believed so strongly in the health benefits of flaxseed that he demanded his loyal subjects eat the seeds and passed laws to make sure of it. The Latin name for flax is Linum usitatissimum, which means "the most useful," and we couldn't agree more. Omega 3's are considered essential because they are necessary for human health and your body can't make them on its own. You need to get your Omega 3's through the foods you eat and flax is the perfect way to add them to your diet. And, flax seeds are one of the best plant-based sources of omega 3's available. title: How to make coconut milk kefir From Poseymom
bullet_point: [Coconut kefir is coconut milk that has been fermented with kefir grains., ike dairy kefir, it provides fuel for the beneficial bacteria in your gut, These good bacteria fight unhealthy bacteria as well as infection, That said, coconut water kefir has nutritional and health benefits worth noting., Kefir is safe for most people to consume, and a single serving is full of vitamins and probiotics. description: How to make coconut milk kefir 1. Add 1 teaspoon of fresh kefir grains to 1 cups of coconut milk. Note: I made my own coconut milk by blending 1 cup of shredded coconut with 2 cups of water and straining the liquid through a nut milk bag. 2. Combine the grains with the coconut milk in a glass jar. Cover with a cloth secured with a rubber bad and let it sit on your bench (a warm environment is best for fermenting) for 12-24 hours. Give your kefir a few shakes or stirs after about 12 hours. 3. Once the coconut milk has thickened and has a slightly sour flavour, it has turned into kefir. Strain the mixture through a fine plastic strainer to remove the grains. Store kefir in the fridge and enjoy. Hints: + Kefir doesn’t like metal, so never use a metal container to make kefir or a metal spoon to stir it. This disrupts the process and the kefir won’t thicken. Use glass containers and wood or plastic spoons. + If your kefir doesn’t thicken with 24 hours, it might be that the temperature in your house isn’t warm enough. + Don’t freak out if your first batch of coconut milk kefir doesn’t get as thick or tangy as you’d like. Mine was tangy, but not super thick. Apparently it can take a few batches to acclimate the kefir grains to coconut milk. You will receive 1 heaping tablespoons of live active Milk kefir grains. That is enough to make a cups every 12 -24hours....Our Milk kefir grains are cultured in Whole Milk.

For many, many years, this was the best coconut milk powder available anywhere in the world.
Add To Endless Meals

description:
Dairy Free. As it Should Be.

We are Ripple. We make plant-based foods that are high in protein, low in sugar, and most importantly, loaded with nutrition and deliciousness.

On-The-Go Non-Dairy Milk: This is our ready to drink, vegan milk in shelf stable, single serving cartons. It’s perfect for your kids’ lunchboxes, as an on-the-go snack, or a healthy addition to breakfast, lunch and dinner.

Ripple non-dairy milk is the most nutritious, delicious and healthy plant-based milk on the market.

Why Peas?
Simply put, pea protein is the best plant based solution there is.

Peas require less water, are more sustainable and have a smaller environmental footprint than dairy or other milk alternatives, reducing impact on the earth and soil. It’s better for the world.

Ripple has 8X the protein of almonds and 50% more calcium than dairy. Ripple is low calorie, high in potassium and omega-3s, meaning it’s better for you.

Lastly, our proprietary pea protein is designed by patented and designed by scientists, so say goodbye to the thin, chalky texture of soy, almond, oat and cashew milk. It tastes better!

Sin lácteos. Como debería ser.

Somos Ripple. Hacemos alimentos a base de plantas que son altos en proteínas, bajos en azúcar, y lo más importante, cargados de nutrición y delicia.

Leche sin lácteos On-The-Go: Esta es nuestra leche vegana lista para beber, en cajas de cartón estables, de una sola porción. Es perfecto para las loncheras de tus hijos, como un aperitivo sobre la marcha, o una adición saludable para el desayuno, el almuerzo y la cena.

La leche ondulada no láctea es la leche vegetal más nutritiva, deliciosa y saludable del mercado.

¿Por qué los guisantes?
En pocas palabras, la proteína de guisante es la mejor solución a base de plantas que hay.

Los guisantes requieren menos agua, son más sostenibles y tienen una huella ambiental más pequeña que los lácteos u otras alternativas de leche, reduciendo el impacto en la tierra y el suelo. Es mejor para el mundo.

Ripple tiene 8 veces la proteína de las almendras y 50% más de calcio que los lácteos. La ondulación es baja en calorías, alta en potasio y omega-3, lo que significa que es mejor para usted.

Por último, nuestra proteína de guisante patentada está diseñada por científicos patentada, así que di adiós a la textura fina y calcárea de la leche de soja, almendra, avena y anacardo. ¡Sabe mejor!

ללא חלב. כפי שזה אמור להיות.

אנחנו אדווה. אנו מייצרים מזון על בסיס צמחי עשיר בחלבון, נמוך בסוכר, והכי חשוב, מלא בתזונה וטעימה.

חלב ללא חלב בנסיעות: זהו החלב הטבעוני שלנו מוכן לשתייה, ביציבות מדף, קרטוני מנה יחידה. מושלם לקופסאות האוכל של הילדים שלכם, כחטיף בדרכים, או תוספת בריאה לארוחת בוקר, צהריים וערב.

חלב אדווה ללא חלב הוא החלב המזין, הטעים והבריא ביותר בשוק.

למה אפונה?
במילים פשוטות, חלבון אפונה הוא הפתרון הטוב ביותר המבוסס על צמחים.

אפונה דורשת פחות מים, הם ברי קיימא יותר ויש להם טביעת רגל סביבתית קטנה יותר מאשר מוצרי חלב או חלופות חלב אחרות, מפחיתה את ההשפעה על כדור הארץ והאדמה. זה טוב יותר לעולם.

לאדווה יש פי 8 מחלבון שקדים ו-50% יותר סידן מאשר מוצרי חלב. אדווה היא דלת קלוריות, גבוהה באשלגן ואומגה 3, כלומר זה טוב יותר בשבילך.

לבסוף, חלבון האפונה הקנייני שלנו מעוצב על ידי פטנט ועוצב על ידי מדענים, אז תגידו שלום למרקם הגירי הדק, של סויה, שקדים, שיבולת שועל וחלב קשיו. זה טעים יותר!

Milchfrei. Wie es sein sollte.

Wir sind Ripple. Wir stellen pflanzliche Lebensmittel her, die reich an Protein, wenig Zucker und vor allem mit Nährstoffen und Leckereien gefüllt sind.

UNTERWEGS Nicht-MILCH: Das ist unsere trinkfertige vegane Milch im Regal stabile, Einzelportionskartons. Es ist perfekt für die Brotdose Ihrer Kinder, als Snack für unterwegs oder eine gesunde Ergänzung zum Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen.

Ripple Nicht-Milch ist die nahrhafte, leckere und gesunde pflanzliche Milch auf dem Markt.

Warum Erbsen?
Einfach gesagt, Erbsenprotein ist die beste pflanzliche Lösung, die es gibt.

Erbsen benötigen weniger Wasser, sind nachhaltiger und haben einen geringeren ökologischen Fußabdruck als Milch- oder andere Milchalternativen, wodurch die Auswirkungen auf Erde und Boden reduziert werden. Es ist besser für die Welt.

Ripple hat das 8-fache des Proteins von Mandeln und 50 % mehr Calcium als Milchprodukte. Ripple ist kalorienarm, reich an Kalium und Omega-3s, was bedeutet, dass es besser für Sie ist.

Schließlich ist unser proprietäres Erbsenprotein von patentierten und von Wissenschaftlern entworfen, also verabschieden Sie sich von der dünnen, kreidigen Textur von Soja, Mandel, Hafer- und Cashew-Milch. Es schmeckt besser!

خالٍ من منتجات الألبان. كما ينبغي أن تكون.

نحن ريبل. نحن نصنع أطعمة نباتية عالية البروتين ومنخفضة السكر والأهم من ذلك أنها غنية بالمغذيات واللذيذة.

حليب لا يحتاج إلى منتجات الألبان أثناء التنقل: هذا هو منتجنا الجاهز للشرب والحليب النباتي في عبوات تخزين فردية ثابتة. إنها مثالية لصناديق الغداء لأطفالك أو كوجبة خفيفة أثناء التنقل أو إضافة صحية للإفطار والغداء والعشاء.

حليب ريبل غير الألبان هو الحليب النباتي الأكثر تغذية ولذيذة وصحية في السوق.

لماذا البازلاء؟
ببساطة ضع بروتين البازلاء هو أفضل حل نباتي موجود.

تتطلب البازلاء مياه أقل، وأكثر استدامة، ولها بصمة بيئية أصغر من منتجات الألبان أو بدائل الحليب الأخرى، مما يقلل من التأثير على الأرض والتربة. إنه أفضل للعالم.

يحتوي التموج على 8 أضعاف بروتين اللوز وكالسيوم أكبر بنسبة 50% من منتجات الألبان. التموج منخفض السعرات الحرارية، ويحتوي على نسبة عالية من البوتاسيوم وأوميغا 3 ثانية، مما يعني أنه أفضل بالنسبة لك.

أخيرًا، تم تصميم بروتين البازلاء الخاص بنا من قبل العلماء وحاصل على براءة اختراع، لذا قل وداعًا للملمس الرقيق من الصويا واللوز والشوفان وحليب الكاجو. مذاق أفضل!

Sem laticínios. Como deve ser.

Somos Ripple. Fabricamos alimentos vegetais com alto teor de proteína, baixo teor de açúcar e, o mais importante, cheios de nutrição e deliciosidade.

Leite sem lactose, pronto para beber, leite vegano em caixas de porção única e estáveis. É perfeita para lancheiras de seus filhos, como um lanche em movimento ou uma adição saudável ao café da manhã, almoço e jantar.

O leite sem laticínios Ripple é o leite vegetal mais nutritivo, delicioso e saudável do mercado.

Por que Peas?
Resumindo, a proteína de ervilha é a melhor solução à base de plantas que existe.

As ervilhas requerem menos água, são mais sustentáveis e têm uma pegada ambiental menor do que as alternativas de laticínios ou outras alternativas ao leite, reduzindo o impacto na terra e no solo. É melhor para o mundo.

A ondulação tem 8 vezes a proteína das amêndoas e 50% mais cálcio do que lactose. A ondulação é de baixa caloria, rica em potássio e ômega-3s, o que significa que é melhor para você.

Ripple 非乳製品牛奶是市場上最營養、美味和健康的植物性牛奶。

description:
Our favorite superfood comes from flax, one of the oldest fiber crops in the world - known to have been cultivated in ancient Egypt and China. Also called 'linseeds,' flaxseeds are a rich source of micronutrients, dietary fiber, manganese, vitamin B1, and the essential fatty acid alpha-linoleic acid, also known as ALA or omega-3. They are so powerful that King Charlemagne of the 8th century believed so strongly in the health benefits of flaxseed that he demanded his loyal subjects eat the seeds and passed laws to make sure of it. The Latin name for flax is Linum usitatissimum, which means "the most useful," and we couldn't agree more. Omega 3's are considered essential because they are necessary for human health and your body can't make them on its own. You need to get your Omega 3's through the foods you eat and flax is the perfect way to add them to your diet. And, flax seeds are one of the best plant-based sources of omega 3's available. Plus, a recent study from Penn State University suggests that plant-based omega 3 sources such as flax are likely just as effective as the well-publicized marine sources in preventing cardiovascular disease.

Son tan poderosos que el rey Carlomagno del siglo VIII creyó tan fuertemente en los beneficios para la salud de la linaza que exigió a sus leales súbditos comer las semillas y aprobaron leyes para asegurarse de ello.
